title: Hong Kong moves to extend crypto licensing rules to brokers, advisers and custodians
content: Hong Kong wants to bring crypto brokers, advisers, asset managers and custodians under its existing regulatory framework.

title: U.S. Senate passes bill to ban prediction market bets on war and death
content: The bill would ban bets on war, assassinations and military operations amid concerns that traders could profit from inside information, as has already occurred.

title: Live news: Bitcoin slips to fresh lows near $60,000 as Anthropic slides after Nasdaq debut
content: BlackRock’s bitcoin ETF saw a record $541.1 million outflow as the U.S. tech selloff spread to Asia, sending South Korea’s Kospi down more than 5%.

title: Bitcoin bots pounced within seconds when researchers exposed their wallet keys
content: University of Liège researchers put a few dollars into deliberately vulnerable bitcoin addresses and watched rival bots race for the money within seconds.

title: ECB’s Lagarde warns Europe could lose control of growing tokenized asset market
content: The ECB president called for common rules as the EU's new blockchain settlement system handled a 1 billion-euro ($1.1 billion) digital bond transaction.

title: DBS bets it can lose the deposit and keep the client
content: The Singapore bank earned a record $208 million in transaction services fees in the third quarter — now it’s helping companies turn deposits into stablecoins they can spend without it.

title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
content: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Lagarde warns Europe could miss chance to unify tokenized markets
content: The ECB president said Europe’s market for tokenized securities could split into platforms that cannot settle trades with one another.

title: Binance hacker moves nearly $600M in ETH, routes funds through THORChain, Chainflip
content: OnChain Lens tracked nearly $600 million in ETH transfers over two days as the Binance hackers moved the stolen funds through fresh wallets and cross-chain protocols to obscure their trail.

title: VanEck to end Gemini ETF custody deals, keeps Coinbase
content: VanEck plans to end Gemini’s custody agreements for three crypto ETFs in February 2027, while Coinbase will continue serving as a custodian for the funds.

title: Senate Passes Bill Banning Prediction Market Bets on War, Terrorism and Death
content: Sen. Adam Schiff's DEATH BETS Act would bar U.S.-regulated exchanges from listing contracts tied to war, assassinations or deaths.

title: Morning Minute: Anthropic IPO Pops, Sinks Markets
content: A (brief) win for Anthropic's ANT stock on IPO day meant a loss for just about every other major asset class.

title: MoonPay Applies for National Trust Bank Charter to Grow Custody and Stablecoin Business
content: The crypto payments firm joins a rush of crypto companies seeking federal trust charters, which face growing political scrutiny.

title: Bitcoin ETFs Shed $582M in a Day as BTC Drops Below $62K
content: Thursday's ETF outflow was the funds' biggest in three weeks, as rising Treasury yields and Fed rate hike bets weigh on crypto.

title: Coinbase Targets In-House Prediction Markets by First Half of 2027: Report
content: The exchange offers event contracts through Kalshi, but running its own would give it more control and a bigger share of trading revenue.

title: Block Says Most Bitcoin Payments on Square Are for Coffee and Food
content: Bitcoin Magazine Block Says Most Bitcoin Payments on Square Are for Coffee and Food Block’s first bitcoin payments report found the median Square payment is about $13, with 72% at food and drink businesses, as it pushes for a de minimis tax exemption. This post Block Says Most Bitcoin Payments on Square Are for Coffee and Food first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Bitcoin Hovers Just Above Average Holder’s Cost Basis as Price Keeps Dipping
content: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Hovers Just Above Average Holder’s Cost Basis as Price Keeps Dipping Bitcoin is trading barely above its realized price, the average cost of every coin, and a break below would put the average holder at a loss for the first time since early 2023. This post Bitcoin Hovers Just Above Average Holder’s Cost Basis as Price Keeps Dipping first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Bitcoin Price Slips Near $61,500 as Tech Selloff Spreads to Asia
content: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Slips Near $61,500 as Tech Selloff Spreads to Asia The bitcoin price slipped to near $61,500 on Friday morning, its lowest level since July, as the tech selloff spread to Asia and IBIT posted a record outflow. This post Bitcoin Price Slips Near $61,500 as Tech Selloff Spreads to Asia first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Inside Bukele’s Casa Presidencial Dinner: Bitcoiners Discuss Energy, Immigration, and El Salvador’s Future
content: Bitcoin Magazine Inside Bukele’s Casa Presidencial Dinner: Bitcoiners Discuss Energy, Immigration, and El Salvador’s Future On November 10, 2026, President Nayib Bukele hosted roughly 30 Bitcoiners at Casa Presidencial during Bitcoin Histórico. Guests included Ricardo Salinas Pliego, Parker Lewis, Mike Peterson, and miners; discussions covered power generation for compute and immigration. This post Inside Bukele’s Casa Presidencial Dinner: Bitcoiners Discuss Energy, Immigration, and El Salvador’s Future first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Juan Galt .

title: Strategy (MSTR) Shares Tumble for Sixth Straight Day to $86 as Bitcoin Slides
content: Bitcoin Magazine Strategy (MSTR) Shares Tumble for Sixth Straight Day to $86 as Bitcoin Slides Strategy shares fell 4.6% to $86.13 on Thursday, their sixth straight decline, as bitcoin dipped below $62,000. The company's 850,849 BTC are now worth about $11 billion less than it paid. This post Strategy (MSTR) Shares Tumble for Sixth Straight Day to $86 as Bitcoin Slides first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
